# The Box Studios of New Orleans

> The Box Studios is a house of music and media in New Orleans, Louisiana — a working recording studio at 7367 Chef Menteur Hwy, and the house around it: publishing administration, licensing of compositions and phonograms, books and their tools, apps, and films, kept in one registry. Door: sales@leasethebox.com.

The house administers publishing through Good Delivery; the artists keep their rights, and the house never takes ownership. Compositions and phonograms are licensed by tier — Lease, Premium, Unlimited, Exclusive — quoted by scope; a buyer receives a use, never the original. Apps carry one price — $9.99, paid once; no subscription. Films are produced and released by the house.

## The house
- [Home](https://theboxstudiosofneworleans.com/): the house and the room at its center, the registry, and the record kept — including JUPETEENTH, the ground on film.
- [The Producer](https://theboxstudiosofneworleans.com/the-producer): Byron Jupiter — producer, engineer, archivist — and the portrait record.
- [The Room](https://theboxstudiosofneworleans.com/the-room): the recording room itself.
- [The Ground](https://theboxstudiosofneworleans.com/the-ground): the owned ground at 7367 Chef Menteur Hwy, New Orleans.
